summary_1line: Skanda defeats Taraka, meets and marries Valli after Narada’s prophecy, returns to Kailasa with both wives, while the demon Gajasura later traps Siva in his heart.

image_candidates.scene_text: Skanda hurls the Brahma missile that beheads Taraka, whose severed head falls at the god’s feet begging union with Siva.
In the garden, Skanda reveals his radiant six-headed form before the astonished Valli and her maids.
Brahma and Vishnu, disguised as wandering performers, make a decorated bull dance while hidden Siva stirs painfully within Gajasura’s chest.
